title: Fix jmap-vtc-chat-integration-guide.md: 11 issues including activeCallId + ring scope
description: MUST-FIX: (1) Lines 107, 195-196: activeCallId described as 'read-only to clients' — spec permits client MAY-write for lazy stale-value repair. (2) Lines 132-133, 161-162: JSON example IDs use non-ULID formats (chat-alice-bob, user-bob, etc.) — VTCCall/Chat/Space IDs must be ULIDs; user IDs follow user:email@host format. SHOULD-FIX: (3) Lines 288, 494: start_call enforcement — guide says MUST, spec says SHOULD. (4) Lines 115-117 vs 181: ring call prose restricts to 1:1 but guide's own table allows group ring — inconsistent with spec (targetParticipantIds is array). (5) Line 444: call history only covers 'missed'/'declined' — omits 'cancelled', 'failed', 'timeout'. (6) Lines 238-243: join flow step ordering wrong — creates VTCParticipant before fetching joinUri. (7) Lines 161-169: chatId and channelId set to same value without explaining they're the same id for a channel. (8) Lines 358-374: MessageAction metadata shape presented as defined but is only an Endpoint example. (9) Line 183: scheduled call type in table but no creation walkthrough. (10) No mention of VTC WebSocket spec / VTCStreamEnable. (11) Lines 216-217: activeCallId atomicity overstated vs spec's lazy-repair.
close_reason: All issues fixed across 11 VTC files
